intro: Tears of the Lady is an urgent mercy task undertaken for Elegael in the forest of Shadowgale. To treat wounded comrades left stranded in the Nightclaw Den, travelers must scour local tree trunks for Lady's Tear, an antiseptic moss vital for binding severe wounds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.
This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.
Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the Lady's Tear?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.
Thank you, friend, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
